name: Harbour City exercise
description: All locations, reports and organizations in this dataset are fictional.

reports.title: Lights out along Dock Street
reports.body: Several shopfronts on Dock Street have lost power. Neighbouring blocks still appear to have electricity.

reports.title: Longer wait on Line 2
reports.body: Passengers report a longer than usual wait for outbound Line 2 services at Central interchange.

reports.title: Water collecting on riverside path
reports.body: A walker reports standing water on a low section of the Riverside walk after heavy rain.

reports.title: Slow mobile data at East Quay
reports.body: A visitor reports intermittent mobile data near the East Quay ferry terminal.

reports.title: Delivery vehicle blocking lane
reports.body: A public report describes a stationary delivery vehicle partly blocking the Market Square access lane.

reports.title: Signal cabinet running on backup
reports.body: A field team reports the intersection signal cabinet has switched to backup power near Northbank station.

reports.title: Crowding at Central platform
reports.body: A separate report describes growing platform crowds. The cause of the delay is not yet clear.

reports.title: Drain overflow near footbridge
reports.body: A second report describes water overflowing from a drain near the pedestrian footbridge.

reports.title: Second report of lost connection
reports.body: Another visitor describes dropped mobile connections near the terminal. Fixed Wi-Fi appears available.

reports.title: Traffic building near square
reports.body: A second report describes a short queue forming behind the blocked access lane.

reports.title: Power interruption acknowledged
reports.body: The exercise utility has acknowledged an interruption affecting parts of Northbank. Crews are being dispatched.

reports.title: Operator confirms service delays
reports.body: The exercise metro operator confirms Line 2 delays and asks passengers to allow extra travel time.

reports.title: Path inspection requested
reports.body: The exercise council has sent a field crew to inspect the low section of the path.

reports.title: Provider investigating connectivity
reports.body: The exercise network provider acknowledges reports of reduced mobile service around East Quay.

reports.title: Station lifts unavailable
reports.body: Northbank station advises that lifts are unavailable during the power interruption. Staff are assisting passengers.

reports.title: Lane restriction confirmed
reports.body: The exercise roads team confirms a temporary lane restriction at Market Square.

reports.title: Platform staff manage queues
reports.body: Staff are directing passengers to distribute along the platform while services run at reduced frequency.

reports.title: Water across the footpath
reports.body: The crew confirms water across the full width of the footpath near the footbridge.

reports.title: Ferry ticket terminals online
reports.body: A field team confirms ferry ticket terminals are online using their fixed connection.

reports.title: Traffic controller on site
reports.body: A traffic controller is directing vehicles around the affected lane. Pedestrian access remains open.

reports.title: Shops close early on Dock Street
reports.body: A second report describes shops closing temporarily. No cause for the interruption has been established.

reports.title: Bus alternative announced
reports.body: The operator has published an alternative bus route between Central and Northbank.

reports.title: Short section of path closed
reports.body: The council closes the affected section of Riverside walk and marks a diversion via Bridge Street.

reports.title: Service issue limited to mobile data
reports.body: The provider describes the issue as reduced mobile data service. It has not reported a general fixed-network outage.

reports.title: Delivery access rerouted
reports.body: The roads team advises delivery vehicles to use the South Gate entrance during the restriction.

reports.title: Crews reach the substation
reports.body: The field team has arrived at Northbank substation and begun inspecting equipment.

reports.title: Delay estimates updated
reports.body: The operator now lists delays of approximately 15 minutes. Estimates may change as services recover.

reports.title: Diversion signs in place
reports.body: The field crew confirms signs are in place at both approaches to the closed path.

reports.title: Public Wi-Fi option signposted
reports.body: Terminal staff have posted directions to the public Wi-Fi access area.

reports.title: Backup generator at community centre
reports.body: The community centre is operating its backup generator while electricity remains unavailable.

reports.title: Recovery vehicle requested
reports.body: A field update reports that a recovery vehicle has been requested for the stationary vehicle.

reports.title: Crowding easing on west platform
reports.body: A platform team reports fewer passengers waiting on the western platform after an additional service.

reports.title: Rain easing at Riverside
reports.body: A nearby report describes lighter rain. The path closure remains in place pending inspection.

reports.title: Intermittent service continues
reports.body: A new public report describes brief recovery followed by another loss of mobile data.

reports.title: Queue remains within access road
reports.body: A field team reports that queued traffic has not extended onto the main road.

reports.title: Utility isolates affected equipment
reports.body: The exercise utility reports that affected equipment has been isolated. A restoration estimate is not yet available.

reports.title: Services remain irregular
reports.body: Passengers report uneven intervals between trains. This is consistent with the current operator notice.

reports.title: Drain clearance in progress
reports.body: Council crews are clearing debris from the affected drain. No reopening time has been announced.

reports.title: Provider working on affected site
reports.body: The provider has assigned a team to investigate the affected mobile site.

reports.title: Recovery vehicle arrives
reports.body: The recovery team has arrived and is preparing to move the vehicle.

reports.title: Adjacent streets remain powered
reports.body: A field inspection finds no interruption on the streets east of the initial affected area.

reports.title: Additional train enters service
reports.body: The operator reports an extra Line 2 service has been added to help clear queues.

reports.title: Water receding on closed path
reports.body: The field crew reports a lower water level but debris remains across the walking surface.

reports.title: Terminal operations unaffected
reports.body: The terminal team reports that scheduled ferry operations continue normally.

reports.title: Restoration work underway
reports.body: Utility crews are carrying out repairs at the substation. The station lift interruption remains in effect.

reports.title: Temporary full lane closure
reports.body: The access lane is briefly closed while the recovery team moves the vehicle. Pedestrian routes stay open.

reports.title: Accessible route reminder issued
reports.body: Station staff remind passengers of the accessible bus alternative while Northbank lifts are unavailable.

reports.title: Cleanup follows drain clearance
reports.body: Crews are removing debris after clearing the drain. The diversion is still active.

reports.title: Mobile data recovery observed
reports.body: A field device has regained a stable data connection. This is one observation, not area-wide confirmation.

reports.title: Vehicle removed from lane
reports.body: The field team reports the vehicle has been removed. Barriers remain while the lane is checked.

reports.title: Partial restoration reported
reports.body: The exercise utility reports power restored to part of Northbank. Some buildings remain affected.

reports.title: Wait times approaching normal
reports.body: The operator reports improving service frequency, with residual delays on outbound journeys.

reports.title: Inspection before reopening
reports.body: The council will inspect the walking surface before reopening the closed section.

reports.title: Provider monitoring recovery
reports.body: The provider reports improvements and is monitoring the site before closing the incident.

reports.title: Road surface inspection complete
reports.body: The roads team has completed its lane inspection and is removing the temporary barriers.

reports.title: Final checks before restoration
reports.body: Crews are checking the remaining circuit. This update does not confirm full restoration.

reports.title: Residual delays continue
reports.body: The final exercise update records minor residual delays. No suspension of the line is reported.

reports.title: Path remains closed for checks
reports.body: The final exercise update keeps the diversion in place until the surface inspection is complete.

reports.title: Monitoring remains in progress
reports.body: The final exercise notice leaves the disruption under monitoring, with no further scope expansion.

reports.title: Market Square access restored
reports.body: The roads team confirms normal access to Market Square has resumed.
